contact_sources.quote: Chief Executive Officer Edward Hugo Edward manages the company’s resources and executes Kernow’s strategy. He began his career analysing technology and cleantech start-up businesses before starting his own company in the consulting sector. Edward was previously the Head of Equity Research at boutique investment bank VSA Capital. He holds an MSc in Microsystems & Nanotechnology and a BSc in Mathematics & Artificial Intelligence. edward@kernowam.com
